description.narrative: USAID Africa Regional is investing in the Afrobarometer project's public opinion surveys on democracy, governance, society and the economy across a range of countries. The data and analysis generated by this project enables the Africa Bureau and Missions to track citizen perceptions of governance in their countries, ultimately contributing to more effective design and implementation of USAID's assistance programs. The Afrobarometer project intends to: produce scientifically reliable data and analysis on public opinion in sub-Saharan Africa; strengthen the capacity of African institutions for survey research; and, disseminate and apply survey results and analysis.
